name: Accounting
description: General ledger for Thai SMEs (TFRS for NPAEs): a ready-made Thai chart of accounts seeded on first use, journal vouchers (JV-2569-0001) that must balance, draft → posted with reversal, monthly period close / reopen, automatic posting of sales invoices, receipts and deposits (incl. withholding tax), goods receipts / returns (with input VAT when the receipt carries it), paid expense claims (expense category → account map with input VAT) and paid payroll runs (salary journal) through editable posting rules with an error queue and retry, and reports: trial balance, general ledger, profit & loss (month + YTD), balance sheet, monthly VAT summary for ภ.พ.30 with output/input tax registers, and withholding tax received (50 ทวิ follow-up).
